igcccg.l: Histology. Gates everything else: seminoma ignores hCG and LDH and has no poor category [nonseminoma = Nonseminoma; seminoma = Seminoma (pure, with a normal AFP)]
Nonpulmonary visceral metastases. PULMONARY metastases do NOT count for this criterion. In nonseminoma this alone is poor prognosis; in seminoma it alone makes the group intermediate.
NONSEMINOMA ONLY. Primary site; a mediastinal primary is poor prognosis on its own. Seminoma permits ANY primary site, so this is not used for seminoma.
NONSEMINOMA ONLY. AFP, post-orchiectomy and pre-chemotherapy. Below 1000 good; 1000 to 10000 intermediate; above 10000 poor.
NONSEMINOMA ONLY. hCG in IU/L, NOT IU/mL, post-orchiectomy and pre-chemotherapy. Below 5000 good; 5000 to 50000 intermediate; above 50000 poor.
NONSEMINOMA ONLY. LDH as a MULTIPLE of the local upper limit of normal, not an absolute value. Below 1.5 good; 1.5 to under 10 intermediate; 10 or above poor.
SEMINOMA ONLY. Whether the AFP is normal. This is a GATE, not a graded marker: a raised AFP means the tumor must be classified as a nonseminoma.

igg4-rd-2020.l: Characteristic organ swelling, mass or nodule
Lymph node swelling only, single organ
IgG4+/IgG+ ratio above 40 percent and over 10 per HPF
